entity_semantics.compiler.symbol: One normalized assertion from the explicitly supplied validated compiler index; it is not automatically a committed source declaration, runtime object, or producer attestation.

binding_state_semantics.in_repository_bound: The defining occurrence resolves uniquely to exact committed bytes and an existing source declaration when one is required.
binding_state_semantics.external_unbound: The SCIP symbol is outside the acquired repository and has no authoritative committed definition in this snapshot.
binding_state_semantics.generated_unbound: The compiler index marks or exposes a generated product whose committed source definition cannot be bound exactly.

identity.canonical_preimage: RFC8785 JSON array prefixed by the domain
identity.collision_behavior: fail before publication; no ordinal, offset, ordering, scheduling, or retry repair

relationship_semantics.RESOLVES_TO: An existing syntax reference is uniquely bound by compiler-index evidence to one committed declaration or one explicitly unbound compiler symbol.
relationship_semantics.REFERENCES: A uniquely identified lexical owner contains one compiler-resolved symbol reference; this does not distinguish call, type use, value use, or runtime access.
relationship_semantics.IMPLEMENTS: The pinned SCIP record explicitly sets is_implementation and both endpoints are unique; existing syntax evidence remains retained.
relationship_semantics.TYPE_DEFINITION: The pinned SCIP record explicitly sets is_type_definition and both endpoints are unique.

forbidden_authority: call inference from a generic reference
generated source declaration without committed binding
